source_refs.note: Nucleoproteins: a main subheading of 4.9 Conjugated molecules, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 128-128.

blocks.text: They are formed by ionic bonds between chromosomal DNA and proteins. For example, histone proteins are bound to DNA to form nucleosomes. They stabilize chromosomal structure in eukaryotes and also play an important role in the regulation of gene expression.
